incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-87321 — pg-primary-prod-us-east-1 connection pool exhaustion (max_clients reached)
incident-bot: Alert details: 95% clients in wait queue, 5xx spike on /v1/generate, metric: pg_max_connections=500, active=498, waiting=47
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created and notified on-call: Sarah (primary), Jin (secondary)
Sarah: ack — jumping in. quick status: are we seeing any errors in API logs or is this the DB timing out?
Mike: API 5xxs started ~2m ago, increased latency on embeddings service. I see repeated ERROR: could not obtain lock for connection in pgbouncer logs.
Jin: Confirmed — pgbouncer max_client is at 400, backends active ~390, wait queue spiking. Also a single batch job launching lots of workers in us-east-1 right now (scheduled job: embedding-refresh).
Eli: I’m going to pause that embedding-refresh job in k8s. Command: 
```
kubectl -n jobs scale cronjob/embedding-refresh --replicas=0
```
Sarah: Good call. Do that and we should also try to add temporary pgbouncer slots. Can we bump pgbouncer max_client and reload?
Mike: We can increase pgbouncer pool and bounce pgbouncer pods one at a time. Running: 
```
# patch configmap
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/pgbouncer-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/MAX_CLIENTS","value":"600"}]'
# rolling restart
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/pgbouncer
```
Jin: Pausing job now — scaled to 0.
ops-bot: embedding-refresh cronjob scaled to 0 by Jin
Mike: Starting pgbouncer config patch, rolling restart in progress. Doing one pod at a time.
Sarah: Meanwhile enable DB fallback route for non-critical endpoints — set feature flag to degrade embeddings to rate-limited fallback that returns cached vectors. Config toggle: `feature.embeddings.fallback=true`
Eli: Toggled flag in console. API teams, expect lower throughput but decreased DB pressure.
Mike: pgbouncer pod 1 restarted — clients dropped briefly, waiting to rebalance. Pod 2 restarting now.
incident-bot: Note: if latency doesn't improve in 5m escalate to DB oncall handoff.
Sarah: I'll run quick psql to check active queries / locks: 
```
psql -h pg-primary.prod-us-east-1 -U redwood -c "select pid, state, query, now() - query_start as duration from pg_stat_activity where state <> 'idle' order by duration desc limit 10;"
```
Sarah: Seeing lots of short-lived connections from worker pool spawning many new sessions (~>200/sec). No long-running lock queries.
Jin: That aligns with pgbouncer queueing rather than DB slowness. Scaling pgbouncer should help.
Mike: After pod restarts, wait queue dropped from 47 -> 5, active stable ~410. API 5xx count down from 18/min -> 3/min.
Eli: Customer impact check: Dashboard shows increased error rate affecting embeddings endpoints for ~140 customers, error budget breach for free tier but paid customers mostly impacted on bulk endpoints. Filing customer-impact note to #customer-success.
Sarah: Good. Please post short status for CS and set expected mitigation timeline ~15m. If we don't recover, plan is to failover read traffic to read-replica cluster in another AZ (read-only fallback) — that requires canary check and DNS TTL update.
Mike: pgbouncer max_clients change applied and all pods up. wait queue back near 0. Monitoring latency.
incident-bot: Automated post: incident status -> mitigated (partial). Root cause suspected: runaway scheduled batch job creating high connection churn that exceeded pgbouncer capacity.
Jin: I'm going to add a short-term connection throttle on worker pool: reduce concurrency env var from 16 -> 4 for embedding workers and deploy. 
Eli: Deployed concurrency change. That should cut connection churn by ~4x.
Mike: API 5xxs returned to baseline. Verified /v1/generate 95th percentile latency back to normal.
Sarah: Great. Actions to follow-up: (1) add circuit-breaker and backoff to embedding-refresh job; (2) set autoscale policy for pgbouncer to increase max_clients automatically during spikes; (3) add runbook step to detect scheduled-job storms and pause cronjob via API.
Jin: I'll open a quick PR for job backoff and add a CI job to test scheduled job concurrency.
Eli: I'll own the pgbouncer autoscale config and the runbook update.
Sarah: Preparing incident summary for postmortem: short description, timeline, mitigation steps, customer impact (approx 140 customers, degraded embeddings 7m), action items + owners. I'll ping once draft ready.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD#INC-87321 status updated to: RESOLVED by Sarah at 4470001408
Sarah: closing thread — if any regression, re-open PD and escalate. Thanks all. :heart:
